svg.title: Edit distance table filling: horse to ros
svg.desc: A 6 by 4 table for turning horse into ros. Row 0 holds 0 to 3 and column 0 holds 0 to 5 (base cases). Cells are filled row by row, left to right. Each cell looks at three neighbours: diagonal (replace or match), above (delete) and left (insert). Where letters match, the cell copies the diagonal; otherwise it is 1 plus the minimum of the three. The bottom-right cell is 3: replace h with r, delete r, delete e.
svg.text: dp[i][j] = edits to turn the first i letters of a into the first j letters of b.
Each cell needs only the row above and the cell to its left, so two rows of length n + 1 are enough.
